## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky32

- [PR #47](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/47): Pass existing `Path` objects through output metadata validation instead of constructing and interning temporary `RootedPath` objects. Preserve file status, symlink, digest, timestamp, and remote-metadata checks.
- [PR #48](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/48): Weakly intern parsed C++ toolchain features after parsing and validation, sharing identical immutable feature trees between configured toolchains.
- [PR #49](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/49): Weakly intern C++ toolchain flag sets during Starlark parsing and deserialization, preserving flag order and action scope. This also shares flag sets retained by action configurations or distinct features. Its memory savings overlap with PR #48 and should not be added together.
- [PR #50](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/50): Add opt-in live compact execution-log streaming through `build.bazel.executionlog.v1.ExecutionLogService.Stream`. Enable it with `--execution_log_compact_file=true --experimental_execution_log_stream_endpoint=grpc://HOST:PORT`. Send zstd-compressed log data during execution and verify the receiver's final SHA-256 digest and byte count. The current transport uses plaintext gRPC; use a trusted endpoint/network. Existing file output and BEP artifact uploads remain available when live streaming is not selected.

### Validation

Passed uncached on Linux remote execution: `ActionOutputMetadataStoreTest`, `FileArtifactValueTest`, `FileStateValueTest`, `FilesystemValueCheckerTest`, `CcToolchainFeaturesTest`, `StarlarkCcToolchainConfigureTest`, `io_tests`, and `ExecTests`. `spawn_log_module` built successfully. All 21 immutable-release publication checks passed. The source PR's live-streaming end-to-end benchmark was not repeated for this release.

### Release publication

Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before publication. The immutable release includes SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations. Existing release tags and assets are preserved.
